name: Type R3
source:
Male students Aida and Niki finally humiliated a lovely girl Yurika on the occasion of their graduation. As though a dam inside of them had broken, they humiliated her over and over again in an abandoned building.....

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026411.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
男学生阿伊达和尼基终于在毕业之际羞辱了可爱的女孩尤里卡。他们内心的大坝仿佛决堤，在一座废弃的大楼里一次又一次地羞辱她……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026411.html]DLsite English[/url]]
